PATHWAY MODULATION: Evidence of downstream immune activation - CD4+ T-cell responses detected in 15/24 patients and CD8+ T-cell responses in 3/24 patients, indicating immune system engagement. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint failed - only 4/24 patients (16.7%) achieved objective response, well below typical efficacy thresholds for melanoma immunotherapy. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: Strong subgroup effect observed - gene signature positive patients (GS+/+) showed 3/8 objective responses vs 1/8 in GS+/- and 0/8 in GS- patients, with median time to treatment failure of 14.8 months vs 2.3-2.4 months in other groups. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design limits interpretation, but the clear subgroup stratification suggests the mechanism works in a biomarker-defined subset.
